protocol.water_magnitude_scenarios: KD490 * (1 + step * provider_percentage_error/100), step=-1,0,+1; no confidence-level interpretation
protocol.depth_scenario_basis: Declared sensitivity bracket given prior 1-4 m depth-label/lidar residuals; no calibrated depth distribution. Canopy-height effects are only approximated by effective-depth perturbation.
protocol.tolerance_basis: Diagnostic reflectance compatibility: earlier r3 clean-scene adjacent-pixel scales were about 0.0009-0.0010 rhos. This fixed tolerance is not validated sensor error, a probability, or an application cover threshold.
protocol.comparison: Equal-unit MAE/bias/RMSE on identical units with baseline predictions; supplementary equal-transect paired differences with descriptive bootstrap and leave-one-group-out range.
protocol.primary_spectra: E5s sensor-convolved pooled taxon-balanced kelp median; equal mean of turf/coralline_crust/red_foliose medians. Fixed before scoring. Spectral quartiles applied coherently per class are stress scenarios, not measured joint draws.
protocol.bands: Blue and green only, actual raster centres for water coefficients and sensor-convolved E5s endmembers. Centre-band approximation retained explicitly. No red/NIR seabed information assumed at these depths.
protocol.selection: Unchanged r1 pixel/area masks. Supported-subset analysis allowed despite v1 whole-scene coverage failure. Mixed-transect and mixed-stratum cells excluded; all exclusions reported.
protocol.fallback: Only the product-qualified same-day fixed KD490 neighbour. Missing source or metadata stops that run; no pixel/date fallback selected by performance. BBP/CDM not jointly fitted.
protocol.application_verdict: Continuous development results only. No application cover-error or minimum-coverage threshold has been specified; no map-ready claim. A close best fit must not be presented as a valid retrieval when nominal reflectance compatibility fails.
protocol.registration_policy: Protocol and code locked in run files before any new real-cover score. Subsequent corrections retain failed runs and an explicit amendment. Old registrations and outputs unchanged.

paired_vs_depth.limitation: At most three transect-number groups; bootstrap interval is descriptive, not confirmatory.
